correctness.rationale: Every consistent receiver uniquely determines a length-(n-1) source word. Exactly q left and q right extensions give 2q minus the constant-word duplicate. Each eligible internal maximal run of length at least ell-1 provides exactly one further parent; inconsistent receivers have at most one parent because the break forces insertion. Packing witnesses within the n-3 interior positions proves the sharp maximum. Run-composition generating functions and a distinct-output incidence double count establish both histograms. Source-and-image exhaustive enumeration 36,924 outputs/66,820 parent incidences independently checks formulae for sampled q,ell,n; the infinite result rests on analytic proof, not experiment.

value.rationale: The exact decoding ambiguity of a single missing overlapping read is a natural worst-case list-decoding invariant. The sharp all-length formula and complete enumerative histogram distinguish consistent reconstructed receivers from unique-parent broken-overlap receivers, quantify a boundary-induced 2q term absent from protected models, and yield a usable exact baseline for analysis of unpadded nanopore/sequence-read channels. It is not a routine substitution of parameters or a small-table recomputation; q, ell, n are arbitrary and the numerator generating function/classification is structural.
